name: Cosmic
weaoDescription:
Cosmic is a budget-friendly premium Windows script executor priced at $14.99 lifetime, featuring:

* Working Multi-Instance
* Decompiler
* 100% sUNC
* Custom UI Support
* Fast updates under normal Roblox update conditions

! Things to keep in mind:

! Cosmic has quickly gained attention in the exploiting community, with some users claiming it performs better than Potassium while being about $8 cheaper, making it an obvious great choice for newer exploiters on a budget and experienced script developers, thanks to its good environment. However, it is still a relatively new executor, so its long-term reliability and lifespan are not yet fully proven.
